result.reason: The added language substantively reaches the preferred position: Vendor covers third-party IP claims, legal violations, Vendor-caused Customer Data breaches, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; Customer and its Affiliates are protected; standard defence procedures apply; and Customer’s indemnity is narrowly limited. The IP exclusions and remedies are also customary. The principal defect is cross-reference execution: the inserted provisions are not visibly numbered, although they refer to Sections 20.1(a) and 20.5, leaving the exclusions, remedies, and existing termination cross-reference technically broken. The margin comment also inaccurately cites Sections 19.4 and 30.5. These are material drafting-quality issues but do not negate the operative indemnity’s substantive alignment.
